## `terrainLabels`

<a id="entry-terrainlabels"></a>

Style 3D map labels by role.

Positional order: `roles`.

| Argument | Type | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `roles` | `dictionary` | Set wrapper CSS for colored, grayed, external, line (route tag), ghost, or label. Callout styles overlay the role. For generated connection labels, color and background style the visible label. |
